models.evaluation: Internal cluster compactness and assignment margin only; no geologic labels exist for this site, so semantic accuracy is NOT evaluated.
models.inference: NumPy (build time); browser reads the label raster
inputs: DEM 5 m (slope, roughness, TPI 100/500 m, curvature at 20 m cells)
limitations: Units are geomorphometric (shape/texture) classes, not geologic or compositional units.
Descriptors are generated by documented threshold rules from centroids.
No imagery, spectra or geologic map is used; none is packaged for this site.
models.name: Geomorphometric terrain units
models.trainingDomain: Unsupervised fit on this site's measured LOLA 5 m DEM features only

models.architecture: Multi-scale Laplacian-of-Gaussian depressions + radial rim-profile fit
models.evaluation: Synthetic analytic-crater unit tests only (position/diameter recovery). No labelled lunar catalogue is packaged for this footprint; precision/recall on real craters is NOT measured.
limitations: Score is a heuristic in [0,1] (depth/diameter, rim closure, rim rise), not a probability.
Degraded and overlapping craters are missed; non-crater depressions may be detected.
Boulders are not resolvable at 5 m posting and are never detected.
models.name: DEM crater detector (classical baseline)
models.trainingDomain: None (not learned). Parameters fixed a priori.

models.evaluation: Not evaluated; outputs are unverified computational hypotheses.
limitations: A statistical outlier is not a discovery.
Gaussian assumption is violated by heavy-tailed slope distributions.
models.name: Geomorphometric anomaly screen

models.architecture: ViT masked autoencoder, temporal + location embeddings (300M/600M)
models.license: Apache-2.0 per model card (verify before use)
limitations: Trained on Earth multispectral imagery; no lunar/Martian domain evidence.
No HLS imagery is packaged for EGIZ Earth windows.
models.name: Prithvi-EO-2.0 (NASA/IBM geospatial FM)

models.license: Apache-2.0 per model card (verify before use)
limitations: Earth-only training domain; using it on lunar DEMs would be unsupported.
